title: Blue, black, silver and a ribbed bottle
label: Brand gallery
lede: Zima’s look barely changed in sixteen years: a clear fluted bottle, a blue and black label and a logo with a bar over the Z. The marks survive in the archive and in two freely licensed photographs, next to our drawings in the same spirit.

archive.caption: The zima.com banner: “Adult humanz only. 21 means 21.”
archive.alt: Banner reading ZIMA.COM, Adult humanz only
archive.credit: Cropped from an Internet Archive capture of zima.com. Shown for commentary; the Zima name and logo belong to their owner.

disclaimer: Colours were sampled by eye from archived captures[^33] and are approximate. Zima is a trademark of its owner and appears here in historical and editorial context. Drawings are original illustrations, not official assets.
